Get Structures From Glydb Data

glydb_structures.Rd

Get unique glycan structures from glydb_data as a glyrepr::glycan_structure() vector.

Usage

glydb_structures(
  structure_level = "intact",
  species = NULL,
  glycan_type = NULL
)

Arguments

structure_level

Either "intact", "topological", or "basic". Default is "intact". See glyrepr::get_structure_level() for details.

species

A string of specie names. See glydb_species() for available specie names. Default is NULL, which means glycans from all species are included.

glycan_type

A string of glycan types. Can be "N", "O-GalNAc", "O-GlcNAc", "O-Man", "O-Fuc", "O-Glc". Default is NULL, which means glycans of all types are included.

Value

A glyrepr::glycan_structure() vector.

Examples

glydb_structures()
#> <glycan_structure[6853]>
#> [1] Glc(b1-3)Glc(b1-3)Glc(b1-
#> [2] Glc(b1-4)Glc(b1-4)Glc(b1-4)Glc(b1-
#> [3] Man(a1-3)[Man(a1-6)]Man(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-
#> [4] Fuc(a1-2)[GalNAc(a1-3)]Gal(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-3)[Neu5Gc(a2-6)]GalNAc(a1-
#> [5] Gal(b1-3)GalNAc(a1-
#> [6] Gal(b1-3)[GlcNAc(b1-6)]GalNAc(a1-
#> [7] GlcNAc(b1-3)GalNAc(a1-
#> [8] GlcNAc(b1-3)[GlcNAc(b1-6)]GalNAc(a1-
#> [9] GalNAc(a1-3)GalNAc(a1-
#> [10] GlcNAc(b1-6)GalNAc(a1-
#> ... (6843 more not shown)
